doc_friction.issue: The pitot proposal gave 45 knots as 320 Pa; ½·1.225·(23.15 m/s)² is 328 Pa. Harmless here because the proposal moved to DONE.md, but proposal figures should be computed, not rounded by eye.

The proposal said the needle 'reads zero on the winch launch'; with a sealed pitot and no drain it reads zero only on the ground run, then rises with height. The story follows the physics; proposals should say which blocked-pitot case they mean.
